sentence: This project trains computer vision models to detect objects in images using the language people naturally speak or write about them.
This project studies how genes, cells, and biological systems work together to shape the characteristics of living organisms.
This project extends a software system that solves systems of polynomial equations and describes the geometry of their solutions.
This project works to protect an open-source electronic health records platform by managing its security vulnerabilities.
This project uses molecular, genomic, and evolutionary approaches to study problems in biology, ranging from cellular and molecular to ecological studies.
This project builds a story-driven hacking game platform that teaches fundamental cybersecurity ideas through quests and lets educators make their own quests.
This project builds a computer tool that uses large language models and graph neural networks to design better cancer immunotherapy cells.
This project studies how hormones control the production of natural products in soil-dwelling bacteria called Streptomyces.
This project develops two nanopore sequencing mini-course research experiences and two micro-credentials, using a method that analyzes DNA or RNA.
This project studies how the brain handles perception, decision-making, learning, and memory using molecular, computational, and developmental approaches.
This project studies how bacteria form round, compact biofilms called granules in wastewater treatment reactors, and how temperature and food affect this.
This project studies how charged droplets break into smaller droplets and how crystallization occurs in evaporating nanodrops.
This project builds a software platform that helps researchers build machine learning systems that are secure and protect privacy.
This project builds AI tools that analyze short videos of young children playing a mobile game to assess early autism risk.
This project develops a Bayesian method to rebuild blood flow in the heart from medical images and measure how uncertain the result is.
